community.title: Community
community.subtitle: Others on similar explorations. Shared journeys, shared science.
community.bannerBody: With your consent, your anonymised data joins a growing dataset. Combined across participants, this supports open publications on how morning routines affect afternoon energy — science that belongs to everyone.
community.emptyIndividualsBody: You'll be able to view and follow other individuals here once others join the service.
community.emptyResearchersBody: You'll be able to view and follow researchers here once researchers join the service.
community.insightCardBody: Across active participants this month, those logging 3+ morning rules reported an average afternoon energy improvement of +1.6 points by week 4. You're on the same track.

multiExplorationBanner.title: Multi-area exploration
multiExplorationBanner.body: Running more than one exploration simultaneously lets you — and the wider community — understand how these health levers interact. Your combined data may reveal correlations that single-variable studies miss.
